PLUS_MONTHLY.name: Plus package monthly fee
PLUS_MONTHLY.waiver: waived for a month if incoming transfers in that month total at least HUF 250,000

ATM_OWN.name: Danubia ATM cash withdrawal
ATM_OWN.rule: first 2 withdrawals per calendar month free, then 0.6%, min HUF 200

LOAN_REMINDER.name: Loan payment reminder letter
LOAN_REMINDER.rule: only if the installment is unpaid on the reminder date; at most one per loan per calendar month

ACCOUNT_CLOSURE.name: Account closure
ACCOUNT_CLOSURE.rule: free if the account has been open for 6 months or more, otherwise HUF 2,000
